title: lichen-node: secure_block1_and_block2_roundtrip test fails on worktree HEAD
description: Pre-existing failure (deterministic, 4/4 reruns) in lichen-node/src/secure.rs test secure_block1_and_block2_roundtrip_replay_order_and_pivs, panicking at secure.rs:2568 (.unwrap() in the blockwise replay sequence around bob.decrypt_request/accept_secure_block1_response). Not touched by worker6-12zy (announce trust store) — no coupling: store is a standalone std module. Discovered while running full lichen-node --features std --lib suite (278 passed / 1 failed). Fails identically with announce_store module present or not (code untouched by that bead).
